stratagems.name: Blood Tithe
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a WORLD EATERS unit from your army destroys one or more enemy models.
stratagems.effect: Your unit gains 1 Blood Tithe point. For every 5 Blood Tithe points your army has accumulated this battle, one friendly WORLD EATERS unit may re-roll all Hit rolls until the end of the current phase.

stratagems.name: Berzerker Charge
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to Charge rolls made for your unit. In addition, your unit is eligible to declare a charge even if it Advanced this turn.

stratagems.name: Khorne's Wrath
stratagems.target: One WORLD EATERS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of models in your unit.
